Your git repository clone converts (some?) new lines from unix to windows.

I've had to run `git config --system core.autcrlf false` and re-clone the repository to get bazel built.

Unsure if it's possible to fix the issue centrally.

@lberki Can you help with this? Thanks.
This sounds like a bug with cc_configure.bzl (and not specific to Windows), so let's assign it to Damien.
(After reading more in details, it looks like an issue with skylark parsing and to be specific to windows).

Can't repro (tried @c1b4175), but this is probably not a great help for you...
- Which version of Bazel are you using (including commithash)?
- Could you give us a copy of `tools/cpp/cc_configure.bzl` from your source tree?

That said, we  want to support Windows eventually, so we'll have to handle CRLF line endings in BUILD files very soon. Let's see what I can do...
